jee-advanced-2027.name: JEE Advanced 2027
jee-advanced-2027.title: JEE Advanced 2027: Exam date, eligibility and registration
jee-advanced-2027.description: Check the 23 May JEE Advanced 2027 exam date, IIT Delhi’s eligibility criteria and where to look for the registration schedule and official papers.
jee-advanced-2027.portalLabel: Check the official JEE Advanced website
steps: Check all five eligibility conditions, including your JEE Main Paper 1 result, first Class 12 appearance and previous IIT admission history. Foreign nationals and OCI/PIO (F) candidates have a separate route.
Follow the Registration section of the official website when IIT Delhi publishes the schedule. Use the current brochure for fees and document requirements.
Use the official paper archive to practise with the previous exam format while you wait.
faqs: Is JEE Advanced 2027 registration open?
IIT Delhi has announced the exam date. Check the Registration section on the official site for the schedule and form when published.
Does qualifying in JEE Main automatically register me for JEE Advanced?
No. Eligible candidates must register separately through the JEE Advanced website during its application window.

srmjeee-2027.name: SRMJEEE 2027
srmjeee-2027.issuer: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
srmjeee-2027.title: SRMJEEE 2027: Application form, phase dates and fee
srmjeee-2027.description: See the SRMJEEE 2027 Phase I and Phase II deadlines, exam dates and ₹1,400 fee per phase. Open SRMIST’s official B.Tech application portal.
srmjeee-2027.portalLabel: Open the official SRMIST admissions portal

evidence.alt: SRMIST dates sheet showing both SRMJEEE UG 2027 exams and application deadlines
evidence.caption: SRMIST’s official SRMJEEE UG 2027 dates sheet.

srmjeee-2027.stepsTitle: Choose a phase and apply through SRMIST
steps: Choose Phase I, Phase II or both. Check the B.Tech programme and campus eligibility before paying for a phase.
Open the 2027 B.Tech application on SRMIST’s website. Prepare the photograph and signature in the formats it asks for.
Review the application and pay the fee on the official portal. Save the application number and payment receipt.
faqs: Do I have to take both SRMJEEE phases?
No. SRMIST lets candidates choose one or both phases.
How much does SRMJEEE 2027 registration cost?
SRMIST lists an application fee of ₹1,400 for each phase.

clat-2027.name: CLAT 2027
clat-2027.title: CLAT 2027: Exam date, registration status and candidate login
clat-2027.description: CLAT 2027 fresh registration closed on 7 November. Check the 6 December 2026 exam date and open the Consortium of NLUs candidate portal.
clat-2027.portalLabel: Open the official CLAT candidate portal
dates: Payment window for existing registrations closed

evidence.alt: Consortium of NLUs press release dated 22 July 2026 stating the CLAT 2027 examination time and date
evidence.caption: Consortium of NLUs press release, 22 July 2026. The exam takes place in December 2026.

clat-2027.stepsTitle: What registered candidates can do now
steps: Log in with the account you used to register and check that your application and payment were completed.
Check the Consortium’s notices and your dashboard for the admit card and exam-day instructions. Follow the reporting time and identification requirements on the official card.
If you missed registration, check the Consortium’s notices for any further update. Do not pay anyone who offers a late registration through another site.
faqs: Can I still start a new CLAT 2027 application?
The Consortium closed fresh registration at 11:59 pm IST on 7 November 2026.
Why is the CLAT 2027 exam in December 2026?
CLAT 2027 is the name of the admission cycle. The Consortium scheduled its exam for 6 December 2026.

cuet-2027.name: CUET UG 2027
cuet-2027.title: CUET UG 2027: Registration timing and subject choices
cuet-2027.description: Check NTA’s indicative CUET UG 2027 registration window and the official notice portal. Compare university subject requirements before choosing your tests.
cuet-2027.portalLabel: Check the official CUET UG notices
dates: NTA’s overview lists February to March 2027
NTA’s overview lists May to June 2027
cuet-2027.stepsTitle: Choose your course before choosing your CUET subjects
steps: List the programmes and universities you would apply to. Read each university’s eligibility rules and note the exact CUET subjects it accepts.
Watch the official CUET UG notices for the 2027 bulletin, required documents, application fee and opening date.
When applications open, register through NTA’s link. Review your selected subjects against each university’s rules before submitting.
faqs: Can I apply for CUET UG 2027 today?
NTA’s overview lists registration from February 2027. Wait for the official application notice and use the link published by NTA.
Does every university accept the same CUET subject combination?
No. Universities set their own programme and subject requirements. Check the requirements for every course you plan to apply for.

viteee-2027.name: VITEEE 2027
viteee-2027.title: VITEEE 2027: Application form, deadline and eligibility
viteee-2027.description: Check the 31 March VITEEE 2027 application deadline, VIT’s tentative exam dates, ₹1,450 fee and official portal for B.Tech admissions.
viteee-2027.portalLabel: Open the official VITEEE application portal
dates: 27 April to 2 May 2027 (tentative, varies by test city)

evidence.alt: VIT’s application payment instructions showing the Indian and overseas test centre fees
evidence.caption: Payment instructions from the official VITEEE 2027 portal.

viteee-2027.stepsTitle: Check your programme before paying VIT’s fee
steps: Check that your Class 12 year, subjects and marks meet the eligibility rules for the B.Tech programme you want. The programmes open to PCB candidates are limited to those listed by VIT.
Complete the application on the VITEEE portal. Check the documents requested for your category and test location.
Review your details, pay on the official portal and keep the application number and receipt. Check the portal for slot booking and admit card instructions.
resources: Official VIT admissions and programme links
faqs: When do VITEEE 2027 applications close?
VIT’s official portal lists 31 March 2027 as the application deadline.
Can I appear for VITEEE 2027 twice?
No. VIT permits one appearance for VITEEE 2027.
